title: Phase 1 Consolidation — EMAIL-CONSOLIDATE: Merge email agents into Flerken
spec:
CONSOLIDATION ACTION: EMAIL-CONSOLIDATE

Five separate projects do variations of "read email and extract value." Flerken wins — it has the most complete architecture (Graph API, GPT-4o, HTML digest, device-code auth).

TASK 1: Audit email-summary-agent
- Read agents/email-summary-agent/
- Review summarizer.py and email_reader.py (or equivalent) for any logic NOT already in Flerken
- List unique capabilities (if any)

TASK 2: Audit Personal Automation
- Read tools/personal-automation/
- Review email_digest.py regex priority patterns (if present)
- Determine if offline/Apple Mail support adds value to Flerken
- List unique capabilities (if any)

TASK 3: Audit delivery-workbench email assets
- Read tools/delivery-workbench/docs/email/ (or equivalent email YAML/configs)
- Check for orchestration patterns (email-inbox-review.yaml, email-morning-digest.yaml) that Flerken lacks
- List unique capabilities (if any)

TASK 4: Port unique logic into Flerken
- For each unique capability found in Tasks 1-3:
  - Copy the relevant code into agents/flerken/src/ as optional modules
  - Do NOT overwrite existing Flerken code
  - Add imports but keep them optional (try/except or feature flag)
- If nothing unique was found, skip this task and note "Flerken already covers all functionality"

TASK 5: Archive completed sources
- Move agents/email-summary-agent/ to _archived/email-summary-agent/
- Move tools/personal-automation/ to _archived/personal-automation/
- Leave delivery-workbench intact (it has non-email purposes)

TASK 6: Update Flerken README
- Update agents/flerken/README.md to reflect any new capabilities added
- Add a "Consolidated From" section noting which projects were merged

TASK 7: Security audit during consolidation
- Run: grep -r "AKIA\\|sk_live\\|ghp_\\|pat[A-Z]" in each source repo before archiving
- Verify .gitignore includes .env, *.pem, *.key, token*
- Confirm no .env files contain real credentials
- Report any findings

TASK 8: Update MASTER_INDEX.md
- Mark email-summary-agent as ARCHIVED
- Mark personal-automation as ARCHIVED
- Update Flerken description if capabilities changed

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT modify .env files or create new API keys
- Do NOT delete anything — only move to _archived/
- Use cp first for porting code, then move originals to _archived/ after confirming
